concept: 执行底线杀的常用棋子
concept_en: Pieces Commonly Used for Back-Rank Mate
question_cn: 哪种棋子最常用于执行底线杀？
question_en: Which pieces are most commonly used to deliver a back-rank mate?

options.text_cn: 马，因为可以越过棋子攻击
options.text_en: The knight, because it can jump over pieces to attack

options.text_cn: 象，因为可以斜线攻击底角
options.text_en: The bishop, because it can attack the corner along a diagonal
The pawn, because it can promote

options.text_cn: 车或后，因为可以沿横线控制整条底线
options.text_en: The rook or queen, because it can control the entire back rank

explanation_cn: 车和后都能沿横线控制整条底线，是执行底线杀最常用的棋子。车尤为高效——单车即可封锁整条横线；后则因机动性强，常先用来引诱对方子力，再配合车完成将杀。
explanation_en: Rooks and queens are the most common pieces for back-rank mates because they can control an entire rank. A rook can seal off the rank by itself, while the queen's greater mobility often helps lure a defender away before the rook delivers mate.
